thread:
Maya: Quick handoff — I'm stepping off oncall at 17:00 UTC, Alex is taking 17:00-01:00 UTC. Short list of things I wanted to call out:
Maya: 1) INF-472 (model cache eviction) — mitigation: temporary throttling rule applied (800 rps/instance). Still seeing retry bursts under peak load. Ticket updated with steps I ran.
Maya: 2) PM-233 (canary rollback flakiness) — patch merged and behind flag redwood.pm233; Jen re-ran evals, looks ok but want 24h monitoring before closing.
Maya: 3) Watch /v1/stream 5xx rate — spiked to ~0.6% at 15:20, currently ~0.12%.

Alex: Taking it. Thanks for the notes. Where did you leave the throttling rule?

Maya: rule is in envoy rate limit cluster "rl-infer" — policy name: infer-temporal-throttle-800. I added details + link in INF-472: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INF-472

SRE-Bot: :white_check_mark: oncall-handoff: Alex assigned for 2026-02-09 17:00 UTC → 2026-02-10 01:00 UTC (rotation id rot-2026-02-09-3)

Ravi: I ran the INF-472 validation on canary at 16:40. Steps: restarted cache-service canary, exercised 5k reqs/min for 10m against canary, monitored evictions. Result: no KV evictions in last 30m. Command I ran:
```
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/cache-service-canary
./test/loadgen --target canary --qps 5000 --duration 600
```
Logs attached to ticket.

Alex: Nice. I'll keep the throttling rule active and watch the graphs. I'll run the smoke script every 15m: `./scripts/smoke_stream.sh --target=canary` and post results if anything >0.2% 5xx.

Jen: Re: PM-233, re-ran the regression eval at 16:30 and 16:45, no accuracy regressions on the eval set we used in postmortem. Flag redwood.pm233 toggled to "on" for canary. Proposal: keep remediation open until 24h of stable metrics, then close.

Maya: Agree with Jen. I'll mark INF-472 as "monitoring" not "done" — leave remediation checklist open.

Alex: Question — if we see 5xx >0.5% should I escalate immediately to eng-platform or try another quick mitigation first?

Maya: If >0.5% across production cluster, escalate to eng-platform and page oncall infra. For canary-only spikes, rotate canary, rollback flag if needed.

Ravi: FYI I also pushed a small logging tweak to cache-service (non-breaking) to emit eviction counts more frequently. PR: https://git.redwood/repo/pull/2345. That should make follow-up easier.

Alex: Thanks. I'll monitor logs and add to INF-472 comments. If anything odd appears I'll ping #eng-platform and @Maya.

Jen: One more ask — can someone confirm smoke script exits non-zero on any 5xx? I ran it locally and it does, but want a prod run check.

Ravi: Yes smoke_stream returns 2 if >0 5xx in run. I added that to the ticket.

Maya: OK, leaving a final note in INF-472 with current state and next checks. Back at 21:00 UTC if you need me. Thanks all for coverage. :thumbsup:

Alex: Acknowledged — taking watch. Ping me directly for urgent.

SRE-Bot: Reminder scheduled: run oncall-check every 15m for Alex until 2026-02-10 01:00 UTC

Alex: Closing loop for now. Will report if any remediation can be closed after 24h of stable metrics.
